Operational decisions for Notion initialization (simulation; no live changes executed):

1. Exact phase order
- Phase A (Structure discovery, creation, reconciliation, and verification gate — must finish completely before any data insertion):
  1. Complete discovery: confirm target workspace, parent page, permissions, and connector capabilities; exhaust search pagination until has_more=false; restore read access to Tasks; reuse the existing verified Projects database by identity and meaning.
  2. Create confirmed-missing required databases and independent base properties: only after has_more=false confirms absence, create missing databases in safe order (Areas, Goals, Projects [reused], Stages, Tasks [only if confirmed absent after access is restored], Inbox, Notes & References) with independent scalar, date, URL (including Drive), file, number-percent, Select, Multi-select, and managed timestamp properties. Preserve native Status on Goals (default Candidate; groups to_do: Candidate; in_progress: Active, On hold; complete: Achieved, Dropped — verified against blueprint and live native-status capability) versus Select Status on the other databases.
  3. Link internal relations: configure all required bidirectional and unidirectional relations using newly verified destination database IDs (never source snapshot IDs).
  4. Configure derived fields: obtain the verified formula expression for required Days Remaining (and any other unknown required formulas) from the user/Notion formula editor or a capable API; never fabricate a formula body. Configure required formulas and dependent rollups only after verified expressions and target relations exist. While any required formula remains unknown, Phase A stays explicitly partial.
  5. Optional components and templates: skip unavailable optional Tasks.Google Drive File relation (rely on native Drive URL; never create an 8th database); skip the source-workspace-specific template; create no templates or sample data.
  6. Phase A verification gate: re-read live schemas for ALL SEVEN required databases (Goals, Areas, Projects, Stages, Tasks, Inbox, Notes & References) and verify every required property, option, relation, and derived field. Persist verified destination IDs in operation evidence (without mutating static plugin snapshots).
- Phase B (User-supplied records only):
  7. Run ONLY after the full 7-database Phase A verification gate passes. Insert only the explicit user-supplied records in dependency order (Areas -> Goals -> Projects -> Stages -> Tasks -> Notes & References / Inbox), so insert goal "launch" in Goals before the one task in Tasks, keeping relations in native properties only, checking invariants, and verifying persisted records.

2. What can be created right now
- No new databases can be created right now. Because the first search has has_more=true, pagination is incomplete (insufficient evidence, U), so no database is confirmed absent and creating any risks duplicates.
- Do not duplicate Projects (reuse the existing verified database) and do not create Tasks while it is unreadable (unreadable is U, not absent).
- Do not fabricate Days Remaining (mark it unknown and request the verified expression); verify native Goals.Status capability/configuration against the blueprint rather than guessing or downgrading it to Select.
- Do not copy the source-workspace-specific template, do not create unrequested templates, and do not insert sample data.
- Safe immediate actions now: finish search pagination to has_more=false, reconcile only known missing independent properties on the already-verified Projects database if safe (excluding unknown formulas and unverified Tasks relations/rollups), and record verified destination IDs in operation evidence.

3. When input records are inserted
- Hold Phase B completely right now. Do NOT insert goal "launch" or the one task yet—even if Goals and Tasks alone were ready.
- Insert "launch" (Goals) and then the task (Tasks) ONLY in Phase B after Phase A passes full live-schema verification across ALL SEVEN required databases, with pagination complete, Tasks access restored, and required formulas resolved.

4. Whether optional external integration blocks setup
- No. Tasks.Google Drive File is an optional external relation and its unavailability does NOT block Phase A or setup. Use the available native Drive URL property instead, and never create an 8th database by inference.
- What DOES block full Phase A completion (and therefore blocks Phase B): incomplete search pagination (has_more=true), unreadable Tasks database, and the unknown required Days Remaining formula (plus confirming native Goals.Status write capability/definition).

5. Smallest next steps to unblock
- Exhaust search pagination until has_more=false.
- Restore read access to Tasks.
- Provide the verified Days Remaining formula body (or accept an explicitly partial Phase A stop while holding Phase B until resolved).
